To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

probiotics can improve the growth and health of piglets by enhancing the abundance of indigenous probiotic bacteria in the gastrointestinal tract and by producing beneficial substances that benefit the host.

1) the gut of piglets is populated by a complex microbiome; 2) the gut microbiota of piglets is influenced by the host, the environment, and the diet; 3) the gut microbiome of piglet benefits from the addition of probiotic lactobacilli that help establish an environment that is favorable for the growth and colonization of indigenous beneficial microorganisms and that helps reduce the risk of enteric infections caused by pathogenic microorganisms.

Probiotic lactobacilli inclusion in piglet diets can improve piglet growth, health, and feed conversion by enhancing the abundance of indigenous probiotic bacteria and reducing the abundance of pathogenic bacteria in the gut.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the roles of Lactobacillaceae and other indigenous probiotics in the establishment of healthy intestinal inter-environment for pathogen defense.
the roles of probiotic lactobacilli in helping piglets establish a healthy intestinal inter-environment for pathogen defense.
the interactions among probiotic Lactobacili, the intestinal environment, and the host.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
probiotic lactobacilli could help piglets establish a healthy intestinal environment for pathogen defense.

the probiotic lactobacilli could be included in the diet of piglets as an alternative to antibiotics, and that the inclusion of probiotic lactobaccilli in the diet of weanling piglets can help establish healthy intestinal environments for the piglets to fight pathogens.
the probiotic Lactobacilllus can help to establish a healthy intestinal environment for pathogen defense.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

probiotic lactobacilli could help establish a healthy intestinal environment in piglets for pathogen defense by improving the abundance, number and diversity of indigenous probiotic bacteria, which could improve piglets growth and immunity.
the gut microbiota is a dynamic and diverse community of microorganisms that plays a crucial role in the development and health of the host.
probiotic Lactobacillii can be used as a dietary supplement for improving the intestinal health in piglets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
probiotic Lactobacillius can help piglets establish healthy gut microbiota and improve the growth and health of piglets.

probiotic Lactobacilllus inclusion can help piglets establish a healthy intestinal environment for pathogen defense by improving the abundance of indigenous probiotic bacteria and enhancing the growth and immunity of piglets through the production of short chain fatty acids and bactericins.
probiotic Lactobacillis could be used as feed supplements for piglets to establish a healthy intestinal inter-environment and to help piglets defend against pathogens.
